title: Synchronized observation-station decision
question: Should a synchronized second observation station be deployed, and under what trigger conditions?

known: Source workbooks and normalized public-safe datasets are preserved with SHA-256 provenance.
The morphology collection contains reproducible angular and image-plane motion measurements.
True range, physical size, altitude, and full three-dimensional velocity remain unresolved.
assumed: Future recurrence may be sufficient to justify additional collection.
A synchronized second station would materially improve range and corroboration potential.
unknown: Whether the observed morphology can be reproduced fully by near-field controls.
Whether the phenomenon will recur during a planned collection period.

uncertainties.label: Recurrence rate
uncertainties.description: How often a decision-relevant observation will recur during the collection window.

uncertainties.label: Conventional-control outcome
uncertainties.description: Whether controlled insect, aircraft, optical, and sensor-artifact tests reproduce the signatures.

uncertainties.label: Available deployment budget
uncertainties.description: Resources available for calibration, hardware, operations, and independent review.

objectives.label: Evidence gain
objectives.description: Expected ability to increase decision-relevant evidence quality.

objectives.label: Affordability
objectives.description: Ability to remain within realistic financial and operating limits.

objectives.label: Privacy protection
objectives.description: Ability to reduce unnecessary collection or exposure of sensitive information.

objectives.label: Reversibility
objectives.description: Ability to stop, revise, or redirect the strategy without disproportionate loss.

relationships.statement: Additional synchronized viewpoints can improve corroboration and enable geometric reconstruction when timing and calibration are sufficient.
Controlled known-target testing can reduce false-positive risk before larger deployment.
A staged strategy preserves the option to scale after defined evidence and recurrence triggers are met.

strategies.label: Reanalyze existing evidence only
strategies.description: Complete calibration review, metadata recovery, and controlled comparison without new field infrastructure.
strategies.action_now: Complete source, calibration, and known-target review.
strategies.monitor: Residual unexplained signatures and recurrence reports.
strategies.trigger: Escalate if controls remain unresolved and recurrence is moderate or high.
strategies.contingency: Close or archive the case if controls explain the observation adequately.

strategies.label: Deploy two stations immediately
strategies.description: Purchase, calibrate, and operate a synchronized two-station collection system now.
strategies.action_now: Acquire and deploy two synchronized stations.
strategies.monitor: Capture quality, recurrence, operating cost, and community impact.
strategies.trigger: Continue while evidence gain remains material and operating limits are met.
strategies.contingency: Suspend deployment if cost or privacy thresholds are exceeded.

strategies.label: Stage a conditional second-station deployment
strategies.description: Finish controls and calibration, prepare the second station, and deploy only after explicit recurrence and quality triggers are met.
strategies.action_now: Complete controls, calibrate the first station, and prepare a second synchronized unit.
strategies.monitor: Recurrence frequency, control similarity, source quality, and budget readiness.
strategies.trigger: Deploy when calibrated observations recur and remain unresolved after controls.
strategies.contingency: Remain in low-cost monitoring mode if the trigger is not met.

scenarios.label: Low recurrence and controls explain most signatures
scenarios.description: Observations are rare and known-target tests reproduce the principal morphology or motion patterns.

scenarios.label: Moderate recurrence with residual uncertainty
scenarios.description: Some conventional controls fit, but a repeatable residual remains unresolved.

scenarios.label: High recurrence and controls remain unresolved
scenarios.description: Calibrated observations recur and conventional controls do not reproduce the relevant signatures.

scenarios.label: Useful recurrence but constrained funding
scenarios.description: Collection remains potentially valuable, but available deployment resources are limited.

human_decision.rationale: The staged strategy preserves immediate learning while avoiding unconditional infrastructure cost before recurrence and control-test triggers are met.
human_decision.next_action: Complete known-target controls and publish the second-station deployment trigger checklist.

act_now: Complete camera calibration and known-target controls.
Prepare the second station without activating full deployment.
triggers: At least two calibrated residual observations within the defined review window.
Known-target tests fail to reproduce the decision-relevant signature.
Second-station timing and calibration readiness pass validation.
contingencies: Remain in single-station monitoring if recurrence is low.
Close or reclassify the case if controls explain the observation.
Seek independent review after synchronized corroboration.
adaptive_pathway.reassessment: Review after 90 days or immediately after a trigger event.
